name: timebox
description: Obsidian plugin that tracks study and work sessions inside your notes, with an optional pomodoro cycle.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:tz: node esbuild.config.mjs test && for tz in UTC Europe/Istanbul America/New_York Europe/London Australia/Lord_Howe; do TZ=$tz node .test-out/core.test.cjs > /dev/null || { echo "core tests failed in TZ=$tz"; exit 1; }; done && echo 'core tests passed in all time zones'

author: Samed Yolcu
